clang-i686-scaffold.purpose: Modern COFF semantic scaffold, not historical matching compiler

clang-i686-size.purpose: Modern size-optimized COFF candidate; permits AL-only byte returns, not a historical compiler claim

clang-i686-scaffold-narrow.purpose: Modern Clang profile retaining partial byte/word register instructions; strict full-function matches only, not a historical compiler claim

clang-i686-scaffold-narrow-fixed-layout.purpose: Modern Clang scaffold preserving narrow instructions and disabling late block-placement; strict whole-function evidence required, not an original compiler claim

msvc71-o2.purpose: Locally supplied historical CL 13.10.3077 under pinned wibo; absent default toolchain permits only explicit source-compilation fallback in build-all. /GS not enabled (default off); /GS- unsupported and rejected.

msvc71-o2-frame.purpose: Local historical CL 13.10.3077 with frame-pointer omission disabled; strict full-function match only. Missing default compiler permits source-only build-all fallback.
